exposure: Operative Vaginal Delivery (OVD) using vacuum extractor
cohort: The study included 3552 primiparas who delivered vaginally at term, a single and living fetus in cephalic presentation, at a single center between January 1, 2010, and December 31, 2014.
finding: In term primiparas, Operative Vaginal Delivery (OVD) with a vacuum extractor increased the risk of Obstetrical Anal Sphincter Injuries (OASIS) by a factor of 5.10 compared to spontaneous delivery.
mod_finding: Operative Vaginal Delivery (OVD) using a vacuum extractor was associated with a significantly higher rate of OASIS (1.23%) compared to spontaneous delivery (0.28%).
birth_weight: Term fetuses; a birth weight of >= 4000 g was identified as a risk factor for OASIS.
